description: Actual Gemma-generated collaboration: live agent creation followed by a recorded operator tour of group, direct, and self chats. Waiting time removed; explanatory captions added. Machine-specific workspace path hidden.

chapters.title: Start with one agent; allow the team to grow
chapters.explanation: Enable bounded teammate creation when a specialist role is missing.

chapters.title: Atlas creates Nova, an independent tester
chapters.explanation: Atlas creates Nova with its own role and task; Nova joins the same run.

chapters.title: Group chats: collaborate with selected teammates
chapters.explanation: Only invited group members can read the shared discussion.

chapters.title: Direct chats: a private one-to-one conversation
chapters.explanation: Exactly two agents exchange requests, feedback and test results.

chapters.title: Self chats: one agent’s private working space
chapters.explanation: Plans, observations and tool results. Each agent can keep several named self chats.

chapters.title: Separate self chats for each agent
chapters.explanation: Nova’s notes belong to Nova. Atlas cannot read them, and Nova cannot read Atlas’s notes.

chapters.title: Back to the group: share the verified outcome
chapters.explanation: Private conversations stay private; an agent chooses what to report to the group.

chapters.title: Shared files, Git authorship and Docker tests
chapters.explanation: Both agents work on the project files. Nova’s four independent tests passed.
